defects.problem: ShowMe card is a large mostly empty white panel, with text clustered top-left and a big dead area at right and bottom; composition looks unfinished.
defects.fix: Centre the lockup in the card or shrink the card to its content.

defects.problem: Transition from the screen to the end card shows a cross-fade of mismatched layouts (faded caption over a faint screen) before the card pops in.
defects.fix: Cut cleanly or fade the whole frame once.

defects.problem: Second URL (github) line is missing in the mid frame yet present in later frames, so the lockup changes height mid-hold; the caption bar shifts between frames.
defects.fix: Reserve space for both lines before they appear.

defects.problem: Small disclosure footers (hackathon, AI narration) are tiny and low contrast under a large empty area.
defects.fix: Enlarge slightly and group with the URLs.

oneLineVerdict: Stable and honest but the close is a plain, half-empty end card with an awkward cross-fade into it.
